how_to_read: Each card is Claude's read of a public Trump post: the affected ticker, whether it implies a BUY / SELL / WATCH, a 0–100 strength score, and why. 'Price since' shows how the ticker actually moved after he posted. Fast signal, but it can reverse on the next post — not financial advice.
